Container.Name: Yharnam-Together-Tailscale
Container.Overview: Yharnam Together dedicated server. Enable Use Tailscale in Unraid, use kernel networking and connect through the container Tailscale IP. No host ports are published. Latest can change; pin the matching release tag with -ts3 suffix. Data directory must be writable by UID and GID 10001; back up the entire directory including link_key.bin. See the README before installing or updating.

Config.Name: Server data
Config.Description: Worlds, databases, settings and server key. Must be writable by UID:GID 10001:10001.
